# llms.txt — QueerCade docs section

This file orients an LLM agent to the documentation resources for QueerCade's catalog platform.

## What this section covers

- REST API endpoint reference with request/response shapes and the envelope format
- Error codes and rate-limit behavior
- MCP tool reference (search_games, get_game, list_collections, get_collection, list_facets)
- Citation guide for queer character information

## Key links

- [Docs for agents](https://queercade.mikedemo.dev/docs)
- [OpenAPI spec](https://queercade.mikedemo.dev/openapi.json)
- [MCP server card](https://queercade.mikedemo.dev/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json)
- [Authentication walkthrough](https://queercade.mikedemo.dev/auth.md) (no auth required)

## When to use this section

Use it when the agent needs endpoint-level detail beyond the overview in /llms.txt — parameter shapes, error codes, or the MCP tool schemas.
